basic_info.description: Exceptional value!  This charming semi-detached home is filled with natural light by abundant windows and skylights throughout.  The spacious basement offers ideal space for your hobby room, home office, workshop or additional storage.  Parking includes 1 car in the garage and 2nd car in the driveway. The backyard features a low-maintenance garden on a level lot.  Conveniently located near the public transit options including the #8 bus line, T Street Car, Caltrain and easy freeway access.  Just minutes from McLaren Park, you can enjoy hiking trails, playgrounds and picnic areas.  This gem won't last! Come to see it soon!!
